notablePrerequisites:
Shorikai and Vhal do not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Tolarian Kraken triggers twice, causing you to pay {2} to untap Vhal and Shorikai.
Repeat.
